analysis.title: Lead AI Quality Engineer
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate has strong hands-on experience in performance engineering, data quality, and Python automation, with practical AI projects (agentic pipeline, lakehouse, LLM research). However, the role demands deep QA leadership, AI-specific testing (LLM evaluation, hallucination, bias), and client-facing consulting in a digital agency context. The candidate's QA experience is indirect (data quality, performance testing) and lacks formal QA leadership or AI testing expertise.
strengths: Strong Python and automation skills, including ETL and data quality validation.
Practical AI experience: built agentic job-search pipeline, lakehouse with Text-to-SQL agent, LLM research.
Experience with performance testing and monitoring (Dynatrace, CA APM) which overlaps with QA concepts.
Consulting background at CA Technologies, delivering client training and monitoring design.
Data quality and pipeline monitoring expertise, relevant to QA frameworks.
gaps: No formal QA title or dedicated QA leadership experience.
No demonstrated experience testing AI/ML features (LLM hallucination, bias, output evaluation).
No experience with agentic AI for test generation or AI-powered testing tools.
No agency or professional services environment experience (though consulting at CA is close).
No direct management/mentoring of QA team members.
tailoring_plan: Tailor resume to emphasize QA-related aspects: data quality validation, performance testing, and automation frameworks. Highlight practical AI projects as evidence of AI-native mindset. Add a summary that positions as a quality-minded engineer with AI experimentation. In cover letter, address gaps by expressing eagerness to learn AI testing and lead QA practice. Emphasize consulting experience and ability to communicate with stakeholders.
